notes.title: Sequel To Wanted Shadows Announced!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm happy to announce Wanted Shadows: Unchained, a [b]standalone reimagining[/b] of 2023's Wanted Shadows. It's rebuilt from the ground up with compact arenas, a deepened progression system, and a hub world that expands the game's world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639492/a48474e780ed2170c25b587e9a25388aa8fe7f8a.gif"][/img][/p][h2]What's New in Unchained[/h2][list][*][p][b]Dual Weapon Combat |[/b] Equip both melee and ranged weapons, so that you can have 2 main weapons at any given time. Exploit their exclusive upgrades to come up with even more powerful combos.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Compact Arenas |[/b] Levels are shorter and more compact. This means the game is more action-packed than ever, and every moment counts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deeper Progression |[/b] With more characters, more upgrades, more powers, and more areas, there's more to do than ever. The new achievement system that adds permanent upgrades to your progression also increases the power ceiling to unprecedented levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Living Hub World |[/b] Interact with characters, and learn more about the Shadows through the added hub world. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44639492/ba0bab3349e4319e89417c75f283df48fa1c9e7b.gif"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Whether you played the original or not, Unchained is the definitive way to experience the tight and chaotic Wanted Shadows gameplay experienced. Also, [b]if you own the original game, you'll get a 50% discount[/b] on this one through the Steam bundle![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/"][/dynamiclink]If you want to support the game, make sure to wishlist it to be notified when it comes out with its launch discount![/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who already played the original game, and I hope you enjoy Unchained with the plethora of improvements and additions we've made![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3990560/Wanted_Shadows_Unchained/"][/dynamiclink]- Conrad, Lead Developer[/p]

notes.title: New Game Announce! Little Laps
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]I'm so happy to announce a new small game from our studio, Little Laps, a one-button racing game inspired by slot cars![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/f8fc19f5f48b597ae64e4ee49800b2856f9d1834.gif"][/img][/p][p]Race through minimalist tracks designed for precision and flow. Master the one-button controls, beat your best times, and experience racing distilled to its purest form.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2642370/Little_Laps/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The game page also released with a demo, so check that out if you want to see what the core experience is like! notes.title: The Wanted Shadows Universe is Evolving!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm happy to announce that a new game set in the universe of Wanted Shadows has been seeing huge developments recently! The game is called [b]Synth Beasts [/b]and it's a [b]Monster Taming Action RPG[/b], think [b]Pokemon [/b]with[b] realtime combat[/b] and an [b]open world[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/2bae74242d2d6c1a353fa5e0e8eb485066adffc5.gif[/img]

I've made a video that you can find below going over them all, so make sure to watch it if you want to stay up to date, but the most important takeaway from it if you want to keep up with the development side of things as closely as possible is that we're going to be running [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]a Kickstarter campaign for the game[/url]! This is for two main reasons:
[list]
[*] Firstly, we want to help fund a part of the console ports so that we can make sure to simultaneously launch on all platforms.

[*] Our second reason is that I personally love involving a game's community as much as possible, and allowing players to leave their mark. With Synth Beasts, we plan on having tons of awesome backer rewards such as making your own monsters, making your own islands, and way way more. Of course, if you just want to support us by getting the game through Kickstarter, you'll be able to get a key for any of the supported platforms!
[/list]
If you want to follow the Kickstarter so that you don't miss out,[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming] click here[/url]. And if you want to know what the recent improvements are, give the video below a watch!

[previewyoutube=E_JLItbVLcA;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I'm looking forward to sharing more Wanted Shadows and Synth Beasts news very soon!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: HUGE Update Out Now (New Character, 3 New Ascensions, 28 New Achievements)!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you all for the positive reception of Wanted Shadows since its release 4 days ago! I've been working hard on an update since then, and here are the patch notes for it!

Also, [b]I would really appreciate it if you left a review[/b]! It's the best way to support the game!

[h1]Version 1.1.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new character, Holig. Stamina depletes instantly when attacking and dashing, but has incredibly fast daze recovery and more power.
[*] Added ascension 4 - Enemies have even more HP.
[*] Added ascension 5 - Enemies move faster.
[*] Added ascension 6 - Enemies move faster over time.
[*] Added achievements for completing all of ascensions 1 through 6 on Tundra.
[*] Added achievements for completing all of ascensions 1 through 6 on Mansion.
[*] Added achievements for completing all of ascensions 1 through 6 on Hell.
[*] Added achievements for beating Hell in ascension 6 for each character.
[*] Increased the cost of all unlockables.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause the game to crash if you obtained the Spider Shock.
[*] Changed the color of the hammer enemy in Hell from purple to white to make it more easily visible.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the special upgrade and level up screens to appear at the same time.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the Hell miniboss to have no entrance animation.
[*] Fixed bug that caused beams to self-proc crit and hence crash the game.
[*] Fixed bug that caused music to be unhearable if there were too many sound effects playing.
[*] Fixed bug that caused fast-acting hitboxes to not register as hits on enemies.
[*] Toned down sound effects on melee attacks.
[*] Fixed some upgrade typos.
[/list]

That's it for the patch notes, but I wanted to mention that if you own Wanted Shadows, you can get our other game, Soul Stalker, at a discount! Also, if you don't own Wanted Shadows but you do own Soul Stalker, then you can get a discount on Wanted Shadows!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

Anyways, that's it for this update, I hope you all enjoy it, and leave a review if you have since it helps so so much :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: New Patch Out Now! (+YouTube video documenting the game's full development)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you all so much with the warm reception with the release! I've made a little patch to fix some issues, you can find the patch notes below.

[h1]Version 1.0.3 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some players reported crashing on obtaining a certain combination of shock upgrades. While I was unable to replicate the crash, I believe that I found the cause of the issue and have made a change that hopefully fixes it. notes.title: Wanted Shadows Releases TOMORROW On Halloween!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've been hard at work finishing Wanted Shadows and tomorrow all of that pays off since it's release day! I wanted to share some stats with you all prior to the release, so you know what to expect... So here you go!
[list]
[*] Costs $1.49 USD.
[*] ~10 hours of gameplay.
[*] 140 in-run upgrades.
[*] 5 characters.
[*] 6 weapons.
[*] 17 equippable powers.
[*] 36 achievements.
[*] 3 levels.
[*] 3 ascensions per level.
[/list]

Our aim with Wanted Shadows was to make it the most action-based and engaging Bullet Heaven, as well as providing a crazy amount of bang for your buck (hence the low price)! We don't work with a publisher that takes a large percentage cut, so this is the reason we can pass on the savings to you!

Another thing I wanted to mention is that if you buy/already own our other game, Soul Stalker, you'll get a discount off of Wanted Shadows, so if you really want to get it for even more dirt cheap, make sure to get it! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I hope you all enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

- Conrad, Lead Developer
